date.as_written: yāte bhujaṃgāṣṭaturaṃgamebde jyeṣṭhe site nāgatithau budhehni / samvat 788 jyeṣṭhaśukla paṃcamī budhavāra

notes: The chronogram bhujaṅga (8) - aṣṭa (8) - turaṅgama (7) gives year 788, confirmed in the Newari text as samvat 788. The catalogue lists the scribe as Gaṇeśa, which is a synonym/variant of the name Gaṇapati given in both the verse (patirggaṇānāṃ) and the prose (śrīgaṇapatina).
